ios.desc:
7 Web
Browse all your favorite websites in one go! 

Choose your favorite websites (Up to 7) that you frequently visit. With a single tap launch all your websites and navigate between them seamlessly with a single swipe.

Auto-sync​ between all your iOS devices with iCloud.

Tech News. World News. Social Network. All Just One Swipe away.

Happy Browsing :)
